title: 【时间囚笼01】平房横尸
slug: 回溯凶案现场全警局坐等我破案
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

出事的地点位于老胡同里边一栋独门独院的小平房。

这胡同附近就是市医院，这一片房子都较为老旧，大多都是对外出租给远道而来求医看病的病人。

在来之前，王猛已经简单复述过报案人讲述的情况——

租住在这个院子里的，是一对从冀城来求医的年轻小夫妻。因为男方的病情需要手术，目前正在等待医院的住院床位。

他们家从前几天开始，外院门从里面用木闩卡着。但居住在周围的大伙儿平时除了去医院，也是很少出门，就都没太在意。

直到这两天胡同里弥漫的臭味越来越严重，大伙儿顺着味道找到这里，才发现这里就是源头。

这才找来房东撬门，发现了里面的两具尸体。

在郭保国推开外院门的那一瞬间，里屋那股腐腥气就已经直直地朝他们扑面而来，呛得人直皱起眉头。

孟长离第一时间屏住了呼吸。

抱一丝，鼻子不欢迎不请自来的味道哈。

“呕～！”

王建军这个还没见过多少大世面的新人，仗着初生牛犊不怕虎，率先探头往里屋看了一眼。顿时感觉五脏六腑都在翻涌，直接跑出去抱着墙根的大榕树大吐特吐了起来。

还有几个因为气味而脸色苍白难看的公安员，索性全部都被郭保国打发去询问周围的邻里邻居，省得一会儿吐里头污染了犯罪现场。

只剩他们几个经验丰富的老刑警还强忍着不适感，开始分工院子里的勘查任务。

郭保国本来也打算让孟长离在外面等着，却发现她已经面不改色地走了进去，便堪堪咽下了到嘴边的话。

路过她身边时，还不忘给她竖起个大拇指。

孟长离只是心虚地挠了挠鼻子。

上辈子见得多也吐得多了，加上能闭气的时间更长，这辈子自然就不那么难受了。

盛夏的老式平房闷得就像是密不透风的蒸笼，连空气都是热的。

他们走进里屋时，发现天花板的老旧铁吊扇还在慢悠悠地转着，发出‘吱呀吱呀’的声响。可这不仅吹不散室内浓重的腐腥气，反而把恶臭卷得满屋子打转。

吊扇正下方，那张简陋的木板床上，仰面躺着一男一女两具尸体。不着寸缕，就这么暴露在空气中。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The place where the accident occurred was a small bungalow with a single courtyard in an old alley.

Near this alley is the city hospital. The houses in this area are relatively old, and most of them are rented out to patients who come from afar to seek medical treatment.

Before coming, Wang Meng had briefly recounted the situation described by the reporter——

The people renting in this courtyard are a young couple who came from Jicheng to seek medical treatment.Because the man's condition requires surgery, he is currently waiting for a hospital bed.

From a few days ago, the outer courtyard door of their house was stuck with a wooden latch from the inside.But everyone living nearby seldom went out except to go to the hospital, so they didn't pay much attention to it.

It wasn't until the stench that permeated the alley became more and more serious in the past two days that everyone followed the smell to this place and discovered that this was the source.

Then the landlord was asked to pry open the door and found two bodies inside.

The moment Guo Baoguo opened the door to the outer courtyard, the rotten smell from the inner room rushed straight towards them, making people frown.

Meng Changli held his breath for the first time.

Hug it, your nose won’t welcome the uninvited smell.

"Ugh~!"

Wang Jianjun, a newcomer who had not seen much of the world, took the lead in taking a look into the back room, relying on the fact that a newborn calf is not afraid of tigers.Suddenly, I felt that my internal organs were surging. I ran out and hugged the big banyan tree at the base of the wall and vomited.

There were also a few police officers who were pale and ugly because of the smell, but they were all sent by Guo Baoguo to ask the surrounding neighbors to avoid vomiting and contaminating the crime scene.

Only a few of them, the experienced old criminal policemen, still endured the discomfort and began to divide the investigation tasks in the yard.

Guo Baoguo originally planned to ask Meng Changli to wait outside, but when he found that she had already walked in without changing her expression, he swallowed his words.

When I passed by her, I didn't forget to give her a thumbs up.

Meng Changli just scratched his nose guiltily.

I saw a lot and vomited a lot in my previous life, plus I could hold my breath for a longer time, so it would naturally be less uncomfortable in this life.

In midsummer, the old-fashioned bungalow is as stuffy as an airtight steamer, and even the air is hot.

When they walked into the back room, they found that the old iron ceiling fan on the ceiling was still spinning slowly, making a "squeaking" sound.But this not only failed to blow away the thick rotten smell in the room, but instead swirled the stench throughout the room.

Just below the ceiling fan, on the simple wooden bed, two corpses, a man and a woman, were lying on their backs.Not even an inch of hair, just exposed to the air.
